title: Sequoia Capital is shutting down its Scouts program
excerpt: Sequoia is ending its pioneering Scouts program as venture capital firms reassess the effectiveness of the model in its current form.
body_html:
Venture capital firm Sequoia is bringing its Scouts program to a close. Sequoia originally pioneered the scouts model, which was subsequently adopted by numerous other venture capital firms across the industry.

A growing consensus suggests that the current format of the scouts model has reached its operational limits. The closure marks the end of an era for a strategy that allowed prominent firms to source investments through a network of individual scouts.
